speaker: Doctor
text: With a CD4 count of 36/mm³, your immune system is severely compromised. The black spots you see could be retinal infiltrates from Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis or potentially Toxoplasmosis. Has your vision been distorted like looking through "smoke," or do you see distinct scotomas (blind spots)? REQUEST TEST: PCR_for_CMV; REQUEST IMAGES: Fundus_photography_right_eye.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Toxoplasmosis Chorioretinitis. The negative CMV PCR, combined with your extremely low CD4 count and history of AIDS, strongly points to *Toxoplasma gondii* as the causative agent. We must start you on anti-toxoplasma therapy immediately.
